name: qrcode
description: Design, build and verify QR codes that are guaranteed to scan — logo in the middle, brand colors or gradients, dot/rounded/leaf modules, custom finders, cards with text — for print or screens. A deterministic engine picks EC level, version, mask and logo size, then gates every design on per-block error budget, structure, contrast, two decoders and robustness sweeps. Cross-platform: runs with uv or a plain Python 3.12-3.14, no system libraries.
